name: baton-knowledge-handover
description: Baton - A structured knowledge-handover tool turning messy docs, chats, and task boards into verified claims with source quotes.

scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix client
